# test_function_inventory.txt — every Test/Fuzz/Benchmark function in the tree, `path: Name`.
# Maintained by test/determinism/test_inventory_test.go. This file only GROWS:
#   new function      -> go test ./test/determinism/ -run TestTestFunctionInventoryOnlyGrows -update-test-inventory
#   deleted / renamed -> hand-remove the line and say why in the commit message. The updater refuses.
# A line that names a function which no longer exists is the gate doing its job, not a stale entry.
